q: Fluid can exert pressure by virtue of their ____.
e: A fluid presses on a surface because of its weight. Fluid can exert pressure by virtue of their weight.

q: Fluid represents states of matter that take the ____ of their containers.
e: A fluid has no fixed shape. It takes the shape of the container. Solids do not. Shape is the term used with Fluid represents states matter that take.
The word fluid covers liquids and gases. Fluid is either liquid or gas.

q: The pressure exerted on a body by the atmosphere due to the weight of the atmosphere is called ____.
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. The pressure exerted on a body by the atmosphere due to the weight of the atmosphere is called atmospheric pressure.

q: At the earth's surface the magnitude of the atmospheric pressure is about ____.
e: Atmospheric pressure is the weight of the air column on a unit area. Near the ground it is about 100 kN m⁻², not 100 N m⁻². At the earth's surface the magnitude of the atmospheric pressure is about 100 kN m^-2.

q: We do not normally feel the large atmospheric pressure because the pressure inside our body is almost the same as the ____ and so balance it.
e: Atmospheric pressure is the weight of the air column on a unit area. Near the ground it is about 100 kN m⁻², not 100 N m⁻². We do not normally feel the large atmospheric pressure because the pressure inside our body is almost the same as the external pressure and so balance it.

q: Nose bleeding which sometimes occurs at a place of low atmospheric pressure is due to the fact that the ____ is higher than the atmospheric pressure.
e: Atmospheric pressure is the weight of the air column on a unit area. Near the ground it is about 100 kN m⁻², not 100 N m⁻². Nose bleeding which sometimes occurs at a place of low atmospheric pressure is due to the fact that the blood pressure is higher than the atmospheric pressure.

q: The atmospheric pressure changes according to ____ and time.
e: Atmospheric pressure is the weight of the air column on a unit area. Near the ground it is about 100 kN m⁻², not 100 N m⁻². The atmospheric pressure changes according to locality and time.

q: The atmospheric pressure at the plains is ____ than that at the hilly regions.
e: Atmospheric pressure is the weight of the air column on a unit area. Near the ground it is about 100 kN m⁻², not 100 N m⁻². The atmospheric pressure at the plains is higher than that at the hilly regions.
